metadata.title: Average a CSV Column
metadata.description: Read a seeded CSV with the csv module and write the column mean to a result CSV.

instructions.main: `data.csv` lives in the workspace with a header row and a `score` column. Write `result.csv` containing a header `average` and one row holding the mean of the scores (7.0).
steps: Read the data: `reader = csv.reader(f)`, skip the header with `next(reader)`, and collect `float(row[1])` for each row.
The mean is `sum(scores) / len(scores)` — divide by the number of data rows, not by every line in the file.

hints.message: `import csv`, read `data.csv` skipping the header, compute `sum(scores) / len(scores)`, and write the result with `csv.writer`.
The header row is not a score — divide the total by the number of data rows (`len(scores)`), not by the number of lines in the file.
The task asks for the mean, not the highest score: total the scores and divide by how many there are — `sum(scores) / len(scores)`.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: result.csv holds the mean of the score column.

test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Print `Wrote result.csv` after writing the file.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: result.csv has the `average` header and the mean 7.0 as a float.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Write `result.csv` with an `average` header row and one data row holding the mean of the scores (7.0).
